sections.title: One species, many vegetables
sections.text: Brassica oleracea is the species behind several familiar crops, including headed cabbages, kale, Brussels sprouts, broccoli, cauliflower and kohlrabi. The plate depicts a headed cultivar; these crop forms mainly differ in the organ selected and enlarged. Flowering plants can exceed 1 m.

sections.title: Edible parts and plate
sections.text: Depending on the cultivar, people eat the leaves, buds, inflorescences or swollen stem, raw or cooked. The plate's four-petalled yellow flowers and siliques fit the species, but do not represent every garden form.
